item.title: 2026 fighting game guide: There's a crazy amount of new titles, updates and DLC on the way this year
item.description: <p>Fighting game players have had a lot of choices on their plate to pick from lately in terms of titles and content, and there's plenty more on the way too.</p> <p>2026 is shaping up to be another big year for fighting games, but what all is coming to the grand stage to look forward to?</p>

item.title: Fist of the North Star x Fatal Fury crossover looks even more likely after SNK Producer drops clear new hint
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/fatal-fury/">Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves</a> wrapped up its first season of content last month with the release of Mr. Big, but there's already more coming to the game very soon.</p> <p>With <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/31/snk-reaffirms-ffcotw-s2-plans/">Season 2 of Fatal Fury kicking off this month</a>, it's looking even more likely that the fighting game is gearing up for another high profile crossover.</p>

item.title: Tekken's history of cut content goes back 30 years including a different title, unused characters and plenty more oddities
item.description: <p>I'm sorry if this makes you feel old, but Tekken's somehow been around for over 30 years now and still trucking along after all this time.</p> <p>Going back to the very beginning, however, there's a ton of content and ideas that never wound up making their way into the games.</p>

item.title: Alex's teaser trailer features some fun references and Easter eggs for Street Fighter 3 and Final Fight that you may have missed
item.description: <p>Although his release date is still likely months away, fans finally got a chance to see Alex in motion inside <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a>'s engine and not just in artwork.</p> <p>Capcom dropped <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/08/alex-teaser-trailer-sf6/">Alex's teaser trailer for Street Fighter 6</a> last night, and there was a loving amount of attention to detail put into the video aimed at longtime fans.</p>

item.title: Awesome mod seemingly adds obscure character from Red Earth into Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3
item.description: <p>We've seen some pretty awesome mods surface for Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3 in recent years. This recent one showcased by <a href='https://x.com/Shumariachi/status/2007981452269654035'>Shumariachi</a> has made a character from Red Earth playable.</p> <p>Red Earth was originally released in the arcades as an RPG and fighting game hybrid back in 1996.
